title: Tensor Decomposition for Non-Clifford Gate Minimization
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires minimizing non-Clifford gates, whose implementation via magic state distillation dominates the resource costs. While $T$-count minimization is well-studied, dedicated $CCZ$ factories shift the natural target to direct Toffoli minimization. We develop algebraic methods for this problem, building on a connection between Toffoli count and tensor decomposition over $\mathbb{F}_2$. On standard benchmarks, these methods match or improve all reported results for both Toffoli and $T$-count, with most circuits completing in under a minute on a single CPU…
